title: How this blog works
excerpt: A template post. It explains how to add writing to this site and disappears the moment you publish something real.

body.text: This post only appears while the site is running locally. It is here so the blog has something to show before the first real piece is written.
Open src/data/blog.ts, copy this entry, and change the fields. The listing page, the archive, the category filters and the individual post page all update by themselves.

items: category is one of Teaching, Research, Analytics, Technology, Travel or Reflections
remove draft: true when the post is ready to go live

body.text: Adding post 2, 3, 10 or 50 should not require changing the page structure — and it does not.
Readers reply through the contact form rather than a public comment thread, so a link to it sits at the end of every post.
